install_attempts.error: Build succeeded. Node v25.2.0 compatible with this 2022 TypeScript codebase. z3-solver 4.15.8 already available.

meta.notes: Pytea installed successfully from source (last commit 2022-04-26, Node v25.2.0). pip install pytea installs an unrelated package (Tiny Encryption Algorithm). The tool analyzes Python/PyTorch code for tensor shape errors without execution, using a TypeScript frontend + Z3 offline solver. Pytea v0.1.0 was used via 'python bin/pytea.py <file>'. For the BUG corpus: all 60 repro files were analyzed with a 60s timeout. 27/60 were Refuted (Pytea detected a shape mismatch or immediate error path). 31/60 were Verified (no error detected — typically because the specific PyTorch API causing the bug was not in Pytea's stub library, so it was silently skipped). 2/60 were N/A (frontend parse failure for Python syntax Pytea cannot handle). For the BLOCK corpus: wrappers were written instantiating each class with no args. 435/488 were N/A (missing helper function/class references from the source library not available in Pytea's stubs, or frontend parse failures). 53/488 were Verified (Pytea found no shape error, but this is uninformative because most APIs in these blocks hit 'attribute not found' and were silently skipped). 0 blocks were Refuted (no actual shape errors detected in blocks).

limitations: Pytea targets shape/tensor errors only; cannot reason about requires_grad / autograd flow, dtype mismatches, or runtime-value-dependent branches.
Pytea requires importable, instantiable nn.Module code; library blocks needing constructor arguments or external helper functions are structurally N/A (same constraint as torch.fx baseline).

Pytea's built-in PyTorch stub library covers only a subset of PyTorch APIs (as of commit 2022-04-26). Modern APIs such as F.scaled_dot_product_attention, torch.isclose, and many transformers ops are absent, causing false 'Verified' (no-error) results on bugs whose triggering API is unimplemented.

Frontend parser (pyright-based) in Pytea cannot handle some Python syntax used in modern PyTorch code (e.g. augmented assignment operators in certain positions), causing 2/60 bug repros to fail parse entirely.
Pytea's last commit was 2022-04-26; PyTorch API coverage has not been updated since then, limiting recall on post-2022 APIs.

Block corpus wrappers call ClassName() with no constructor arguments; most blocks require non-trivial args (channel counts, config objects), causing constructor-level 'name not found' failures that map to N/A rather than genuine shape analysis.

Pytea reports 'Verified' when it cannot analyze a code path due to missing stubs — this is an unsound approximation (false negative). Users must inspect the LOGS section for 'attribute not found' warnings to detect this.
Z3 offline analysis is only reached for paths that pass the online (TypeScript) phase; paths where Pytea lacks stubs never reach Z3.
